rationale: The expanding-life pilot did not establish initial thermal mastery. Do not infer plasticity loss or fix pressure-specific features. Use known-resolvable exogenous signal tasks, same post-change stimulus streams for fresh/experienced controls, and the unchanged controller.
falsification: Screen identity fresh and late first: at least2/3 fresh final and2/3 experienced base-final greedy success>=.85 is required before interpreting the other changes. If this fails, stop the full matrix and run only preregistered gamma0/lambda0 immediate-feedback diagnostic (same tasks/default actor/critic steps); do not rank algorithms. If screen passes, test channel/action/noise8/noise32/neutral, each fresh and late,3 seeds,20k per phase. Record final greedy success, live windows, AUC, time to two live windows>=.85, experienced-minus-fresh and exact learned/frozen base-prefix hashes. Stable control shows whether late deficits are specific to a change. Neutral first-phase reward is constant1; effects remain observable. Counts/activity are not knowledge. Need-free pre-exposure benefit requires faster subsequent learning than matched fresh need learning, not just commands or final reward. All outcomes exploratory diagnostic; no broad generalization claim or post-hoc seed replacement.

protocol.scope: Open microdiagnostics; revealed workbench is not an optimization target
protocol.controls: learned/frozen prefix and fresh post-condition; exogenous streams match; oracle/constant/random audit

statement: Open contextual diagnostics distinguish failure to learn a simple observed rule, post-experience adaptation limits, distractor sensitivity, and absence of useful neutral pre-exposure in the frozen generic actor-critic.
direction: diagnostic of representation, adaptation and acquisition without needs

sources.title: Maintaining Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning
sources.implementationDifference: Fixed random-feature actor/critic has no learned neural representation to which continual backprop can blindly be applied; these are controlled capability diagnostics, not reproduction.
sources.evidence: Loss of ability to learn new data differs from forgetting old data; prior exposure versus fresh capability must be distinguished.
